Name: (CP and AT) BBs New Livestock- Horseshoe Crabs
Author: Bibliobeast
Description:
[b][size=4]Increase your animal diversity by adding Horseshoe Crabs to your barn! Collect all 5 Varieties![/size][/b]
Crawling from the sea, a motherly horseshoe crab wanders a little too far and lays her eggs in Marnie's yard. She keeps them moist and warm, and after 3 days they hatched into tiny living fossils! Their cuteness is undeniable, despite the naysayers...

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b][list]
[*]Adds horseshoe crabs as a new animal to Marnie's shop! 
[*]Come in 5 varieties, with hatch probabilities as follows: Atlantic (default), Cave (20%), Lucky (10%), Mystic (10%), Cosmic (10%)
[*]Horseshoe crabs will produce eggs every day (drop overnight) that can be aged in a preserves jar, doubling its value!
[*]Incubate using an ostrich incubator in the barn to hatch a horseshoe crab larva! 
[*]After 4 hearts of animal friendship, horseshoe crabs [u]may[/u] drop vials of hemocyanin, happiness effects drop likelihood so be sure to love your crabs!
[*]Larvae will hatch after 5 in game days, and mature into adults after 3 days
[/list][size=4][b]Installation Notes[/b][/size]
[u][size=3][b]Content Pack [CP]
[/b][/size][/u]This mod requires both SMAPI and Content Patcher to work correctly! 
Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "[CP] BBs New Livestock: Horseshoe Crabs"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[u][size=3][b]Alternative Textures [AT][/b][/size][/u]
﻿This mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher, Alternative Textures, and [CP] BB's New Livestock: Horseshoe Crabs to work correctly! 
Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
Download and unzip "[AT] BBs New Livestock: Horseshoe Crabs"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
In game, purchase the AT mod scissors from Robin (red and blue coloured), left click on your horseshoe crab and select a skin!

[size=4][b]Patch Notes
[/b][/size]Ver 1.1- Fixed a texture bug preventing skin changing for adult crabs

[b]Future Update Wishlist
[/b]Possible Coop version using the baby crabs as 'adults' (mini-crabs?) and creating new baby texture for more farm inclusion flexibility. 

If you have any requests or suggestions please leave a comment or shoot me a message! :>
